name: Fling to Climb!
desc:
🧗 Welcome to Fling to Climb! 🎉
Can you master the art of flinging and reach the top? Grab, launch, and conquer the ultimate climbing challenge! 🚀

[THIS GAME WILL CAUSE A PHENOMENON KNOWN AS RAGING, BE ADVISED!😡]
If you think you were banned falsely, contact us by joining the communication server.
[PLEASE REPORT ANY BUGS EXPERIENCED!⚠️]
⚠️ HACKING = INSTANT PERM BAN ⚠️

🕹 How to Play:
🔹 Click & Hold onto rock walls to grip!
🔹 Release while moving the mouse/screen to launch yourself upward! 🎯
🔹 Navigate through obstacles like lava, ice, and wind! ❄️🔥💨
🔹 Reach checkpoints to save your progress! 🏁
🔹 Collect coins and roll for awesome skins! 💰🎲

💡 Game Features:
✅ Shop & Inventory – Unlock and equip unique skins! 👕✨
✅ Perks & Power-ups – Extend your grab, fling players, and more! ⚡🤝

🔸 First-person mode required for the best experience!
🔸 High sensitivity recommended for quick, precise movements!

Do you have what it takes to Fling to Climb? 🏆🔥
